name: Triple-barrier meta-labeled reversion (spot)
rationale: Meta-labeling on a mean-reversion primary: the PRIMARY signal is bare oversold (RSI below a fitted floor) and decides only the SIDE (long spot the dip). A SECONDARY regularized-logistic classifier decides whether to ACT, trained expanding-window and point-in-time on which of the three barriers (stop / take-profit / time) each past oversold entry hit first, netted of cost (win=1 else 0), reading RSI depth, Bollinger z-score, realized vol and perp funding at entry. Size/skip only — never flips direction. HONEST PRIOR: identical to the momentum sibling — meta-labeling amplifies an existing edge and spot reversion after costs has not shown one, so a powered FAIL is expected; the value is a clean, leak-free test of whether the secondary model can rescue the primary on the holdout (it almost certainly can't on spot's thin history).
catalyst: secondary model green-lights an oversold dip-buy in a regime where reversion has historically paid
